description:
Unlock the Secrets Hidden Beneath the Mountain in This Immersive Escape Room Adventure

A mysterious portal pulls you into a forgotten temple, hidden deep within a vast underground cave system. As you explore the temple’s ancient halls, you'll uncover hidden notes left by Theo, a once-trusted friend. His discoveries have awakened something powerful and dangerous — and now it’s up to you to solve the puzzles, discover the truth, and decide your own fate.

Every room you enter is filled with challenges, secrets, and hidden mechanisms. You'll need sharp observation, creativity, and patience to solve the puzzles and continue your journey. The feeling of opening a puzzle box, unlocking a hidden passage, or revealing a forgotten machine is at the heart of the experience.

Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets is built for players who enjoy escape rooms, room games, and solving intricate puzzle boxes. Each room is a new challenge, carefully designed to reward exploration and attention to detail. Hidden levers, mechanical contraptions, and mysterious symbols fill the temple, waiting for you to uncover their secrets.

As you move deeper into the temple, you'll piece together the story of what happened to Theo, and you’ll be faced with important choices. Your decisions will shape how your journey ends.

• An Escape Room Adventure in a Fully 3D World
Inspired by classic adventure games and real-world escape rooms, Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets brings the excitement of puzzle-solving into a beautiful and immersive 3D world. Every room feels like stepping into a giant, interactive puzzle box, where every surface could be hiding a clue or a secret.

The rooms are filled with mechanical puzzles, hidden switches, secret doors, and visual clues that reward players who pay close attention. Exploration is key, and each solved puzzle brings you closer to uncovering the mystery hidden deep within the temple.

Whether you're moving heavy stone doors, activating ancient steam machines, or solving intricate mechanical devices, every puzzle feels satisfying and connected to the story.

• Choose Your Way to Play
Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets offers two difficulty modes to suit your style:

- Normal Mode: Includes a dynamic hint system that offers subtle clues if you get stuck. Hints build up slowly, from small suggestions to a full solution if needed.

- Hard Mode: No hints at all. A pure escape room experience for players who want the ultimate challenge.

In Normal Mode, the hint system is always optional and gives you the freedom to solve puzzles at your own pace. In Hard Mode, every solution must be earned through careful thinking and exploration.

• Atmospheric Puzzle Adventure
The temple is brought to life with detailed 3D environments, atmospheric lighting, and a soundtrack that draws you deeper into the adventure. The visual style blends ancient stonework with steampunk-inspired machinery, creating a world where every room feels alive with secrets.
Each room has its own mood and mystery, making the temple feel like a series of interconnected puzzle boxes. Exploring each space feels rewarding, with hidden clues woven naturally into the environment.

• Features:
- Deep, story-driven escape room adventure
- Fully 3D environments combining ancient temples and mechanical marvels
- Challenging mechanical puzzles and hidden clues
- Inspired by real life escape rooms
- Dynamic hint system: gentle help when needed.
- Multiple endings based on the choices you make
- Immersive soundtrack and detailed visual design
- Perfect for fans of escape rooms, room games, and puzzle-solving adventures
- Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Swedish
- Available with Play Pass

If you love discovering hidden rooms, unlocking ancient mechanisms, and solving clever puzzles, Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets is the escape room adventure you’ve been waiting for.
Explore, solve, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the mountain.
